messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx and DNS lookup failures reported from EU customers (eu-central / eu-west). Potential GeoDNS/Route53 propagation issue. Pager: sara (primary) paged at 04:12 UTC. :rotating_light:

Sara: ack. Triage starting. Tagging #eng-sre and ricardo for DNS routing.

aj: awake, will standby. Can run traffic steering if needed.

ricardo: logging into Cloudflare and AWS consoles now. Running traceroutes and dig across public resolvers.

lia: SLO monitor fired ~04:08 UTC for eu cluster: error rate 10% on generation endpoints, mainly 502/504.

maria: support queue shows a cluster of EU customer tickets reporting timeouts and stale content from edge.

ricardo: initial `dig +trace` shows intermittent SERVFAILs from Route53 EU name servers; some public resolvers returning older A records.

ricardo: paste: ```
; <<>> DiG 9.11 <<>> +trace api.redwood.io @1.1.1.1
;; global trace ...
api.redwood.io. 60 IN A 52.48.12.34
;; got SERVFAIL from ns-eu-west-2.route53.amazonaws.com.
```

Sara: sounds like Route53 regional resolver cluster is flapping and our GeoDNS fallback isn't switching fast enough.

aj: what are current DNS TTLs for geo records? can we expedite failover?

lia: TTL is 60s nominal for geo config, but we see propagation delays with some resolvers ignoring low TTLs. Autoscaling unaffected; this is purely reachability/DNS.

ricardo: I'm going to apply a manual override in Route53 to prefer global endpoints for EU queries (set geo fallback weight). Doing it now (04:20 UTC).

maria: filing INC-20089, drafting status page: "Partial DNS resolution failures affecting EU customers; working on routing mitigations." tagging enterprise customers.

eve-support-bot: Incident INC-20089 created by maria. Initial severity: SEV2.

ricardo: override applied at 04:22 UTC. Also requested lowering Cloudflare edge cache TTL for A records where allowed.

Sara: note: we can't globally change authoritative TTL quickly; Cloudflare edge adjustments should help. Lia, keep watching SLOs.

aj: running probe `curl -I https://api.redwood.io/health` from eu-west probe: got timeout then 502.

lia: metrics show partial improvement starting 04:26 UTC; error rate trending down but some resolvers still referencing old, unhealthy endpoints.

Sara: handing off to aj at 04:30 UTC for the next 30m. I'll stay in channel for context.

aj: taking over. I'll coordinate with Cloudflare and AWS support, and run broad dig probes.

ricardo: opened AWS support case, note: intermittent packet loss towards Route53 name servers in eu region. Case ref: AWS-80233.

maria: publishing preliminary status update to status.redwood.com. Notifying top affected accounts directly.

eve-support-bot: Status page updated (prelim).

aj: mitigation checklist: 1) keep GeoDNS manual override to global pool 2) ask Cloudflare to purge/refresh edge records 3) escalate to AWS for Route53 regional cluster 4) monitor and plan rollback once stable.

lia: runbook suggestion: if authoritative provider returns SERVFAIL, ensure fallback weight threshold kicks in within TTL window; add postmortem action to harden this.

ricardo: Cloudflare support replied: they see egress failures at some EU PoPs, applying routing fix now. ETA 10-20m.

aj: probes at 04:40 UTC show NXDOMAIN/SERVFAIL count decreasing. EU error rate ~3%.

maria: sending direct messages to 3 impacted enterprise contacts with incident link and ETA (1h) for full remediation.

Sara: good handoff. I'll create postmortem ticket and assign owners: ricardo (DNS/router), lia (monitoring + playbooks), maria (communications).

aj: note to self: revert manual GeoDNS override only after AWS confirms Route53 cluster healthy.

ricardo: AWS case updated at 04:55 UTC; they're running additional checks and recommend keeping our failover until cleared.

maria: updating INC-20089 with timeline, customer list, mitigations, and pager log.

aj: final probe at 05:03 UTC shows EU resolvers returning healthy endpoints and error rate <1%. I'll keep override on for 10 more minutes then coordinate revert.

eve-support-bot: Incident INC-20089 severity downgraded to SEV3 (05:10 UTC).

Sara: thanks team. Follow-ups: add TTL/playbook improvements to postmortem; consider multi-resolver probing and synthetic checks for resolver SERVFAILs.

maria: will schedule customer follow-ups including summary and actions taken.

ricardo: exporting dig traces and Cloudflare logs to attach to postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-20089 mitigated; postmortem pending.

aj: logged follow-up actions on incident board and will coordinate final revert. :white_check_mark:
